title: 第一卷 第19章 新徒入峰第一卷 第20章 魔修上门
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
其他峰主，话语硬生生卡在喉咙里，都瞪大了眼睛，盯着赤瑶身侧那柄长剑。
整个青云宗也就只有几位峰主拥有天品法器，且这法器还是花大价钱拍来的，原本的法器在十年前的仙魔大战中都损毁了。
如今，林枫竟然直接送给一个刚要入门的弟子。
刚才还满脸胜券在握的震炎，怔愣的看着林枫，内心闪过一个恐怖的念头，这林峰……不会是在扮猪吃虎吧？
他自顾自地摇摇头，冲着林峰说道：“林峰主！你这十年不都没去下过山吗，这天品神剑是怎么来的？！”
“呃……你得了这么一把好剑，怎么不跟我们说呢，也好去给你道贺。”
台下的弟子没有注意到台上的暗流涌动。
数万参选弟子直接炸开锅，场上响起喧嚣声。
“我的天！随手就送天品神兵？这也太豪横了！”
“这么一比，那些口头招揽廉价得可笑。”
……
林枫转头看向震炎，微微一笑：“自然是下山拍卖来的。”
演武台中央，烈赤瑶仰头望着台上的林枫，身旁天品灵剑散发的力量萦绕着她。
她没有想到，这个最后开口的长峰主，会给她这么大的惊喜。
看到林枫正笑着和岩崖峰峰主说话，他的气质非常仙风道骨，笑起来又显得儒雅随和。
她对林枫的好感顿时直线上升。
赤瑶红唇微扬，褪去一身桀骜，对着高台之上的林枫，单膝跪地，声音洪亮道：
“弟子赤瑶，愿拜林峰主为师！”
这话落下，全场再度寂静。
没办法，今天在青云宫弟子大典上发生的事情都太过惊奇了！

一是今天出现了一位万年难遇的赤炎道体。
二是他们上山前就已经打听好的，千万不要拜林峰主为师，可今天他竟然直接掏出了一个天品神兵！
三是一还拜了二为师。
震炎身躯一晃，气急攻心差点当场失态。
之前自己在其他峰主面前信誓旦旦，觉得赤瑶这朵花必定落入岩崖峰。
现在却被林峰截胡了。
林枫眼底掠过一抹淡笑，慵懒地端坐在高台上。
“既入我小竹峰，便守我三条规矩。”
“不忤逆师命，不卑躬屈膝，不做欺师逆徒。”
“能做到三点，我便收你为徒。”
赤瑶重重叩首：“弟子铭记师尊教诲，此生谨遵师命，绝无二心！”
“叮！恭喜宿主收天骄赤瑶为徒弟。”
“专属收徒任务完成！”
“目前赤瑶好感度：30”
“获得本源天地灵气一缕，资质+2、百倍暴击抽奖一次！”
一连串系统提示音在林枫脑海响起。
一股暖流瞬间席卷全身，他的灵根，在今天悄无声息的完全修复了。
与此同时，全宗门的弟子看向林枫的眼神都带上了一丝敬畏。
这林峰主将来可能会师凭徒贵，望徒成凰啊！即便以后没有师凭徒贵，今天他能够把排名第一的弟子收入麾下也是一种本事。
收徒大典落幕，青云宫恢复了往日的平静，只是平静当中多了一点生机。

外门弟子私下议论着。
“以前嘲讽小竹峰没落的人都出来，谈谈自己的脸疼了没。”
“这谁能想到，林枫确实沉寂了十年。”
“今天的林峰主风范和当年一样呢，好帅啊！”
一番言论被震炎的神识尽收于耳，他回到岩崖峰，气得砸碎了桌子，面色阴鸷狰狞。
content_en:
The words of the other peak masters were stuck in their throats, and they all stared at the long sword beside Chi Yao with their eyes wide open.
There are only a few peak masters in the entire Qingyun Sect who possess heavenly magic weapons, and these magic weapons were bought at a high price. The original magic weapons were destroyed in the war between immortals and demons ten years ago.
Now, Lin Feng actually gave it directly to a disciple who was just about to get started.
Zhen Yan, who had a confident look on his face just now, looked at Lin Feng blankly, and a terrifying thought flashed through his heart. This Lin Feng... wasn't pretending to be a pig to eat the tiger?
He shook his head to himself and said to Lin Feng: "Master Lin Feng! Haven't you been down the mountain in the past ten years? How did you get this heavenly sword?!"
"Uh... you got such a good sword, why don't you tell us so that we can go and congratulate you."
The disciples in the audience did not notice the undercurrent on the stage.
Tens of thousands of disciples who participated in the election immediately exploded, and there was a loud noise on the field.
"Oh my god! Just give away a heavenly weapon casually? This is too arrogant!"
"By comparison, those verbal solicitations are ridiculously cheap."
…
Lin Feng turned to look at Zhen Yan and smiled slightly: "Of course it was auctioned down the mountain."
In the center of the martial arts stage, Lie Chiyao looked up at Lin Feng on the stage, the power emanating from the Tianpin Spirit Sword beside her lingering around her.
She didn't expect that the Peak Master who spoke last would give her such a big surprise.
I saw Lin Feng smiling and talking to the master of Yanya Peak. His temperament was very fairy-like, and he looked elegant and easy-going when he smiled.
Her favorable impression of Lin Feng suddenly skyrocketed.
Chi Yao's red lips slightly raised, her arrogance faded away, she knelt on one knee facing Lin Feng on the high platform, and said in a loud voice:
"Disciple Chiyao, I would like to become Master Lin Feng as my teacher!"
After saying this, the whole place fell silent again.
There is no way, what happened at the Qingyun Palace Disciple Ceremony today was too surprising!
One is that a red flame Taoist who is rare to see in ten thousand years appeared today.
Secondly, they had already inquired before going up the mountain not to take Master Lin as their master, but today he actually took out a heavenly magic weapon!
Third, one also worshiped the other as his teacher.
Zhen Yan's body swayed, and he was so angry that he almost lost his composure on the spot.
Previously, I had sworn in front of other peak masters that the flower of Chiyao would definitely fall into Yanya Peak.
Now he was intercepted by Lin Feng.
A faint smile flashed across Lin Feng's eyes, and he sat lazily on the high platform.
"Now that you have entered my Xiaozhu Peak, you must abide by my three rules."
"Do not disobey the teacher's orders, do not grovel, do not deceive the teacher and rebel against the disciples."
"If you can do three things, I will accept you as my disciple."
Chiyao kowtowed heavily: "Disciple, I will bear in mind Master's teachings, and I will obey Master's orders throughout my life without any second thoughts!"
"Ding! Congratulations to the host for accepting Tianjiao Chiyao as his apprentice."
"The exclusive mission of recruiting disciples is completed!"
"Current favorability of Chiyao: 30"
"Get a ray of spiritual energy from the original world, +2 qualifications, and a hundred times critical hit draw!"
A series of system prompts sounded in Lin Feng's mind.
A warm current swept through his body instantly, and his spiritual roots were completely repaired quietly today.
At the same time, all the disciples in the sect looked at Lin Feng with a hint of awe.
This Peak Master Lin may become a master and a disciple in the future, hoping that his disciple will become a phoenix! Even if it is not as valuable as master and disciple in the future, it is still a skill for him to be able to take the number one disciple under his command today.
The apprenticeship ceremony came to an end, and Qingyun Palace returned to its previous calm, but with a little more vitality in the calm.
The outer disciples were discussing privately.
"Everyone who used to mock Xiaozhufeng's decline has come out to talk about whether their faces hurt."
"Who would have thought that Lin Feng has been silent for ten years."
"Master Lin's demeanor today is the same as before. He's so handsome!"
All these remarks were heard by Zhen Yan's consciousness. He returned to Yanya Peak and smashed the table in anger, with a sinister expression on his face.
